newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares up in light trade at mid-morning.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares up in light trade at mid-morning.

text.p: The Singapore stock market was slightly higher in light trading on Thursday morning, dealers said.
"The market is still trying to find a firmer footing and some direction," a dealer with a European bank said.

The key Straits Times Industrials Index was up 2.37 points at 2,167.56 at 0230 GMT. Market volume was light at 15 million with gainers leading losers at 79 to 61. Dealers said most of the actives were dominated by blocked deals. Dairy Farm saw 305,000 shares blocked at Singapore $0.631 (US$0.45), Hotel Properties 500,000 shares at S$2.177 and ST Capital 300,000 shares at S$1.719.

Amalgamated Industries led the gainers at S$4.42, up S$0.22 on 36,000 shares. It was followed closely by City Development at S$11.80, up $0.20 on 159,000 shares. Shangri-La Hotel rose S$0.10 to S$5.00 after its results were within expectations. The firm also announced a one-for-four bonus issue.

Creative Technologies led the losers, shedding S$0.80 to S$8.40 after the company and Samsung denied rumours of a takeover by the latter. Dealers said the drop also reflected its softer U.S. price on Wednesday.
